scenarios.name: One consequential choice
scenarios.setting: home studio at a garden threshold
scenarios.activity: a solo founder reviews a paper field notebook beside a closed laptop
scenarios.key_message: The founder governs consequence instead of supervising constant activity.

scenarios.name: Many gardens
scenarios.activity: a portfolio operator compares three distinct venture folios
scenarios.key_message: One operator can preserve the distinct identity and viability of several ventures.

subject_direction.demographics: Realistic adult founders and operators across genders, skin tones, ages 30–55, and small-business disciplines; never a homogeneous executive cast.
subject_direction.style: Everyday natural materials, functional clothing, no conspicuous luxury or startup-uniform cosplay.
subject_direction.expression: Attentive, reflective, or quietly relieved; no exaggerated excitement or fear.
subject_direction.diversity_notes: Diversity should appear as ordinary reality, not a staged group shot. Preserve dignity, realistic skin texture, and non-tokenizing context.

shot_list.generation_prompt: Candid documentary photograph of a South Asian solo founder in their late 30s reviewing a paper field notebook at a simple worktable beside an open garden door; closed laptop and brass circular instrument nearby; right-third placement, soft left negative space, overcast daylight, calm stewardship, no legible data or AI clichés.
shot_list.label: Illustrative — generated brand expression, not customer evidence
